en: We saw that projects solve the repeated
context problem. So we can provide tones,
structure, examples,
all that kind of information
in one project without having to add this
information again and again in a new chat.
But actually, this information is typically
not always a text file on our machine.
Information like this is on Google Drive, in
Gmail, in Sheets in the cloud, so it's not
always located on your machine.
And the workflow we saw so far would mean
that we always have to download or copy
paste the source material
into ChatGPT.
There is a better solution for that, and
this solution are apps.
Apps allow you to connect ChatGPT to lots of
different tools or applications. To then
retrieve information or send information to
these applications.
Now, I won't dive too deep into apps right
here. I just want to give you a quick
example on how we can use such apps in the
text generation context.
Now, when using those apps, you of course
have to be aware that AI has access to the
apps you will grant it access to. So in our
case, if I'm searching for Google Drive and
use the Google Drive app, then ChatGPT can
access my Google Drive. And although
typically things shouldn't go wrong, you can
never be 100% sure that things won't go
wrong. So I highly encourage you, if you try
this app feature, only use it with accounts,
with apps where you don't have any sensitive
information stored. My goal now is that
I want to connect ChatGPT
to my Google Drive application.

which is interesting for our finance
project. So I'll first connect the app, and
then try to retrieve that information inside
this project.

select Connect. Which will redirect us to
Google Drive here in this case, and where
you will then see a list of
the access
OpenAI or ChatGPT will have for this
account. And in my case, I will select all
as I'm fine with that. It's just a demo

any sensitive information.
Now I continue.
And now I can find this app here.

I cannot find this
